response.sql: WITH filtered_labs AS (SELECT * FROM Laboratory WHERE WBC > 6.5), centromea_stats AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, AVG(CASE WHEN GOT IS NOT NULL AND GPT IS NOT NULL THEN GOT - GPT END) as avg_got_gpt, AVG(CASE WHEN APTT IS NOT NULL AND PT IS NOT NULL THEN APTT - PT END) as avg_appt_pt FROM filtered_labs GROUP BY CENTROMEA) SELECT AVG(avg_got_gpt) as result1, AVG(avg_appt_pt) as result2 FROM centromea_stats
